title: Wage Adjustment in Efficient Long-Term Employment Relationships
title_zh: 高效长期雇佣关系中的工资调整
authors: Elsby, Michael W. L., Gottfries, Axel, Krolikowski, Pawel, Solon, Gary
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We present a model in which efficient long-term employment relationships are sustained by wage adjustments prompted by productivity shocks and outside job offers. These wage adjustments occur only sporadically, due to the presence of renegotiation costs. The model is amenable to analytical solution, yielding new insights for several labor market phenomena, including: (1) key features of empirical distributions of changes in pay among job stayers; (2) a near-“memorylessness” property in wage dynamics whereby hiring wages have only limited influence on later wages and allocation decisions; and (3) a crucial role for recruitment and retention bonuses in sustaining efficient employment relationships.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个模型，其中高效的长期雇佣关系通过生产率冲击和外部工作机会引发的工资调整得以维持。由于存在重新谈判成本，这些工资调整仅偶尔发生。该模型可进行解析求解，为若干劳动力市场现象提供了新见解，包括：（1）在职者薪酬变动的经验分布的关键特征；（2）工资动态中近乎“无记忆性”的特性，即入职工资对后续工资及配置决策的影响有限；（3）招聘奖金和留任奖金在维持高效雇佣关系中的关键作用。

title: Investment Targets as Reference Points
title_zh: 投资目标作为参照点
authors: Petra Vokata, Aleksi Pitkäjärvi, Matteo Vacca
official: 官方在线 2026-07-12 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We provide the first evidence of forward-looking reference points in investor behavior. Combining administrative data on option traders with a stacked difference-in-differences design, we show that investors' propensity to sell options spikes precisely when the underlying asset crosses the strike price, which retail investors frequently select to match their target price. The effect is difficult to explain using the standard disposition effect, nominal returns, salience, option Greeks, or complex option trading strategies. Moreover, the effect is present only for options bought out of the money, for which the strike price acts as a natural target, but absent for options bought in the money, for which it does not. The evidence is most consistent with investors evaluating gains and losses relative to a forward-looking target, in sharp contrast with the backward-looking purchase price widely used in the disposition effect literature. Our findings suggest that standard tests of reference dependence in selling decisions are misspecified when investors evaluate outcomes relative to reference points other than the purchase price.
abstract_zh: 我们首次提供了投资者行为中存在前瞻性参考点的证据。通过将期权交易者的行政数据与堆叠双重差分设计相结合，我们发现，当标的资产恰好突破行权价时，投资者出售期权的倾向会急剧上升，而散户投资者经常选择该行权价以匹配其目标价格。这一效应难以用标准的处置效应、名义收益、显著性、期权希腊字母或复杂期权交易策略来解释。此外，该效应仅存在于价外买入的期权中（此时行权价充当自然目标），而在价内买入的期权中则不存在（此时行权价不构成目标）。这一证据最符合投资者基于前瞻性目标评估损益的行为，与处置效应文献中广泛使用的后顾式买入价格形成鲜明对比。我们的发现表明，当投资者以买入价以外的参考点评估结果时，关于卖出决策中参考依赖的标准检验存在设定偏误。

title: Sovereign Risk and Natural Disaster Shocks: Unraveling the Domestic Yield Curve Response
title_zh: 主权风险与自然灾害冲击：国内收益率曲线反应的解析
authors: Mr. Kangni R Kpodar & Alassane Drabo & Carine Meyimdjui
official: 官方在线 2026-07-03 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper investigates the impact of natural disasters on the domestic sovereign yield curve, shedding light on their distinct transmission channels. Using a sample of 72 developing countries during the period 2000-20, and leveraging a newly compiled dataset on domestic treasury bill and bond yields, the findings from the fixed-effects and the local projection difference in difference estimations point to a disaster premium in the pricing of domestic government securities. While natural disasters significantly steepen the yield curve, their effects are confined to short-term maturity debts. In constrast, a worsening in climate vulnerability shifts upward the entire yield curve. Heightened fiscal stress and monetary policy stance emerge as the main transmission channels. These results underscore the importance of integrating resilience building into debt management and fiscal policy frameworks.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了自然灾害对国内主权收益率曲线的影响，揭示了其独特的传导渠道。基于2000-20年间72个发展中国家的样本，并利用新编制的国内国库券和债券收益率数据集，固定效应模型与局部投影双重差分估计的结果表明，国内政府证券定价中存在“灾害溢价”。自然灾害显著陡化了收益率曲线，但其影响仅限于短期债务。相比之下，气候脆弱性的恶化则使整条收益率曲线上移。财政压力加剧与货币政策立场成为主要传导渠道。这些结果凸显了将韧性建设纳入债务管理与财政政策框架的重要性。

title: Cashless tax systems: voluntary vs. mandated digital payments in Eswatini
title_zh: 无现金税收系统：斯威士兰自愿与强制数字支付的比较
authors: Fabrizio Santoro, Phindile Masuku, Tanele Magongo
official: 官方在线 2026-07-09 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: The digitalisation of tax payments is a growing policy priority in low- and middle-income countries, particularly in Africa, where revenue mobilisation remains a challenge. This study examines the impact of digital tax payments on compliance, leveraging a 2021 zero-cash-handling mandate in Eswatini. Using administrative tax data, we evaluate two key questions: (i) how voluntary adoption of digital payments affects compliance and (ii) the impact of mandating digital tax payments. We employ a staggered difference-in-differences (DiD) approach for voluntary adoption and a treatment-intensity DiD strategy to assess the mandate’s effects. Voluntary adoption significantly improves compliance, reducing late payments by 19–20% points (25–30 per cent reduction) and increasing payment accuracy (paying the tax liability in full) by 5.6% points (20 per cent), but for strictly digital payments only. Effects on tax amounts paid are less consistent, but the fully controlled broad-digital specification implies an increase of approximately 32%. The mandate, by contrast, eliminated cash payments and is associated with an approximately 17% increase in tax paid on average. While companies pay more taxes, they also worsen their payment accuracy, while individuals are more likely to pay their tax liabilities in full after adoption. These findings highlight distinct compliance patterns between voluntary adopters and those compelled by enforcement. The results underscore the importance of designing digital tax policies that account for taxpayer heterogeneity and behavioural responses to maximise compliance gains.
abstract_zh: 税收支付数字化是低收入和中等收入国家日益重要的政策优先事项，尤其是在税收动员仍面临挑战的非洲地区。本研究利用斯威士兰2021年实施的"零现金处理"强制令，考察数字税收支付对税收遵从的影响。基于行政税收数据，我们评估两个关键问题：（i）自愿采用数字支付如何影响税收遵从；（ii）强制推行数字税收支付的影响。针对自愿采用行为，我们采用交错双重差分法；针对强制令效果，则采用处理强度双重差分策略。自愿采用显著改善税收遵从：严格数字支付场景下，逾期支付率降低19-20个百分点（降幅25-30%），支付准确性（全额缴纳税款）提升5.6个百分点（增幅20%）。对实缴税额的影响虽不一致，但完全控制的广义数字支付模型显示增幅约为32%。相比之下，强制令彻底消除了现金支付，平均实缴税额增加约17%。企业虽缴纳更多税款，但支付准确性下降；而个人在采用后更可能全额缴纳税款。这些发现揭示了自愿采用者与强制遵从者之间的差异化遵从模式。研究结果强调，数字税收政策设计需考虑纳税人异质性与行为反应，以最大化税收遵从收益。

title: Growth, Firm Scale, and the Energy Intensity of Production
title_zh: 增长、企业规模与生产的能源强度
authors: Kathryn McDonald, Noémie Pinardon-Touati, Conor Walsh
official: 官方在线 2026-07-02 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We uncover a new mechanism that links growth and a decline in the energy intensity of production, observed globally since 1990. Using microdata from India and a causal research design, we demonstrate that the expenditure share of energy declines steeply with firm scale, due both to physical scaling laws and technology investment. Given that average firm size increases with growth, this scale dependence implies that production endogenously becomes less energy-intensive along the growth path. We develop a model of this mechanism in general equilibrium, and quantify significant reductions in aggregate energy intensity as low-income countries like India grow. We conclude with a discussion of the future path of emissions in India.
abstract_zh: 我们揭示了一种新机制，该机制将经济增长与1990年以来全球观察到的生产能源强度下降联系起来。利用印度微观数据及因果研究设计，我们证明企业能源支出份额随规模扩大而急剧下降，这既源于物理规模法则，也源于技术投资。鉴于企业平均规模随经济增长而扩大，这种规模依赖性意味着生产在增长路径上会内生地降低能源强度。我们构建了该机制的一般均衡模型，并量化了印度等低收入国家经济增长过程中总体能源强度的显著下降。最后，我们探讨了印度未来排放路径。

title: Narrative topics and oil
title_zh: 叙事主题与石油
authors: Zhengxu Yan, Qunzi Zhang
official: 官方在线 2026-07-02 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study whether economic narratives extracted from financial news predict crude oil returns. Using 1.22 million articles from The Wall Street Journal spanning from 1986 to 2022, we apply seeded latent Dirichlet allocation (sLDA) to measure 14 time-varying narrative topics. The empirical results show that narrative topics, including war narratives, outperform traditional predictive models in forecasting crude oil returns. The results remain robust after controlling for standard macroeconomic variables, financial market variables, and uncertainty measures. In addition, we identify the economic mechanisms through which narrative economics contributes to crude oil predictability. Specifically, narrative topics operate by affecting real economic activity, uncertainty, and crude oil supply shocks.
abstract_zh: 本文研究从财经新闻中提取的经济叙事是否能够预测原油收益。基于1986年至2022年间《华尔街日报》的122万篇文章，我们采用种子潜在狄利克雷分配（sLDA）方法，测度了14个时变叙事主题。实证结果表明，包括战争叙事在内的叙事主题在预测原油收益方面优于传统预测模型。在控制标准宏观经济变量、金融市场变量及不确定性指标后，该结果依然稳健。此外，我们识别了叙事经济学对原油可预测性产生影响的经济机制：具体而言，叙事主题通过影响实际经济活动、不确定性及原油供给冲击发挥作用。

title: States as Financiers: International Lending in War and Peace
title_zh: 国家作为金融家：战争与和平中的国际借贷
authors: Sebastian Horn, Carmen M. Reinhart, Christoph Trebesch
official: 官方在线 2026-06-22 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: States are major international financiers, but their role is poorly understood. We study state-driven cross-border lending over two centuries using a new database covering 1.2 million official loans and grants by 134 governments and 70 multilateral institutions since 1790. We document a dual, state-contingent structure of international credit. In normal times, private creditors dominate cross-border lending. In adverse states of the world, such as wars and financial crises, official creditors step in, at times on a massive scale. These official flows are driven by great powers, are highly subsidized, and are largely absent from canonical models in international macroeconomics.

title: Self‐esteem and rational self‐handicapping
title_zh: 自尊与理性自我妨碍
authors: Rachel Mannahan
official: 官方在线 2026-06-01 · 来源：RSS
abstract: People may create or seek out performance‐inhibiting obstacles to avoid negative feedback about their ability. This behavior, called self‐handicapping, allows agents to attribute failures to self‐imposed obstacles rather than to lack of competence. I model rational agents with preferences for maintaining self‐esteem, and provide sufficient conditions under which they engage in rational self‐handicapping behavior. I consider two policy applications: education and tournaments. Exams with noisier questions strictly increase studying. Policies encouraging particular groups to apply for jobs can result in strategic adjustment, decreasing applications from the targeted group.

abstract: This paper investigates how capital supply from mutual funds affects municipal bond financing, making three key contributions. First, we introduce an identification strategy using the rule-based update of Morningstar ratings for 5-year-old funds, isolating supply-side effects from fund and issuer fundamentals. The results indicate that exogenous fund flows increase bond issuance probability and decrease yields. Second, these fund flows lead to more issuances when funds and issuers are connected through underwriters, highlighting relationship lending in municipal bond financing. Third, municipal issuers leverage favorable financing conditions for new issuance of revenue bonds, which translates into higher local house prices. (JEL G23, G32, H74)
abstract_zh: 本文研究共同基金资本供给如何影响市政债券融资，并作出三项关键贡献。首先，我们引入一种基于晨星评级规则更新的识别策略（针对成立满五年的基金），从而将供给端效应与基金及发行人的基本面因素相分离。结果表明，外生性基金流入会提高债券发行概率并降低收益率。其次，当基金与发行人通过承销商建立关联时，此类基金流入会带来更多债券发行，凸显了市政债券融资中的关系型借贷特征。第三，市政发行人利用有利融资条件发行收益债券，进而推高当地房价。（JEL分类号：G23, G32, H74）

title: The Effect of Retaining High-Skilled International Graduates: Evidence from the STEM OPT Extension
title_zh: 保留高技能国际毕业生的效应：来自STEM OPT延期的证据
authors: Seoyoung Kwon, Jongkwan Lee, Joan Monras
official: 官方在线 2026-02-26 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: High-skilled migration programs exist around the world in the hope that immigrants complement native workers, allow firms to grow, and boost innovation. We study the effect of one such program by exploiting the 2016 extension of the Optional Practical Training (OPT) program, which significantly prolonged the work authorization period for international STEM graduates. Using a synthetic difference-in-differences approach, we find that the policy successfully increased the local supply of high-skilled immigrants in exposed Commuting Zones. This local inflow stimulated firm creation and the demand for native high-skilled workers. The program might have also boosted innovation in certain sectors and startup investment, especially in Commuting Zones hosting top-ranked universities, where, overall, the effects tend to be larger.
abstract_zh: 全球范围内存在高技能移民项目，旨在期望移民能够补充本土劳动力、促进企业扩张并推动创新。我们通过研究2016年选择性实习培训（OPT）项目的扩展（该政策显著延长了国际STEM毕业生的合法工作期限），分析了此类项目的影响。采用合成双重差分法，我们发现该政策成功增加了受影响通勤区的高技能移民本地供给。这种本地流入刺激了企业创立以及对本土高技能劳动力的需求。该政策还可能促进了特定行业的创新和初创企业投资，尤其是在拥有顶尖大学的通勤区——这些地区的整体效应往往更为显著。

title: Peer Effects in Austrian Schools
title_zh: 奥地利学校中的同伴效应
authors: Rudolf Winter-Ebmer, Nicole Schneeweis
official: 官方在线 2005-04-23 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This study deals with educational production in Austria and is focused on the potential impact of schoolmates on students? academic outcomes. We used PISA 2000 data to estimate peer effects for 15 and 16 year old students. The estimations yield substantial positive effects of the peer groups? socioeconomic composition on student achievement. Furthermore, quantile regressions suggest peer effects to be asymmetric in favour of low-ability students, meaning that students with lower skills benefit more from being exposed to clever peers, whereas those with higher skills do not seem to be affected much. Social heterogeneity, moreover, has no big adverse effect on academic outcomes. These results imply considerable social gains of reducing stratification in educational settings.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨奥地利的学校教育产出，重点关注同学对学生学业成果的潜在影响。我们利用PISA 2000数据，对15至16岁学生的同伴效应进行估计。估计结果显示，同伴群体的社会经济构成对学生成绩具有显著的正向影响。此外，分位数回归表明，同伴效应存在不对称性，且有利于低能力学生，即技能较低的学生更易从与聪明同伴的接触中受益，而技能较高的学生似乎未受显著影响。同时，社会异质性对学业成果并无显著负面作用。这些结果意味着，减少教育环境中的分层现象可带来可观的社会收益。
